title.narrative: Preparatory Study on Enhancing Youth Participation in Uganda

description.narrative: The study seeks to evaluate the current state of youth engagement in decision-making processes, identify barriers to participation, and collaboratively design a concept for a pilot project. We will map stakeholders and establish an understanding of the needs of the target group - aged 15�35, focusing on creating innovative approaches to participation. Key themes, such as climate action and mental health, will be integrated into the framework. Activities during the study include stakeholder consultations, workshops, and context analysis to co-create a blueprint for the pilot project, as well as explore the partner organisation�s current forums, workshops, mentorship programs to enhance youth involvement in community decision-making.
